profile.name: 套接字通信器
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于把网络套接字封装成类似文件的读写接口，方便实验控制框架通过套接字与仪器或远程服务交换原始字节数据，并管理地址、终止符、超时、输入缓冲区和连接关闭等通信属性。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that wraps a network socket as a file-like I/O interface, allowing a laboratory control framework to exchange raw byte data with instruments or remote services over sockets while managing address, terminator, timeout, input buffer flushing, and connection closure.

registry.name: Open Standard Socket Communicator
registry.description: Socket Communicator驱动，支持address/close/flush input/read raw/seek等9个操作。
